item.description:

The additional effect of yesterday’s successful kidnapping operation in Gaza

Yesterday’s kidnapping of Muin al-Arabid, commander of Hamas’s Internal Security Apparatus from the heart of Gaza City, granted Israeli intelligence a major intelligence treasure—a great deal of information Israel seeks about Hamas’s most closely guarded secrets is held between al-Arabid’s ears.

But beyond the operational success of the action—whose intelligence benefit has yet to be fully realized—there is another significant effect: a severe blow to the perception and image of Hamas’s narrative of control and dominance over the territory and the streets of Gaza.

A special Israeli force / acting on behalf of Israel entered the heart of darkness—the very center of Hamas’s rule—and extracted the man responsible for securing Hamas’s senior officials and for thwarting collaborators—like those who provided the information that led to his abduction.

For many Gazan users (and for me as well), yesterday’s operation recalled the exposure of the Sayeret Matkal force in Khan Yunis in November 2018.
Only this time, the mission was completed successfully and without casualties.

Hamas’s ability to secure the area it controls, both militarily and in terms of security, was significantly compromised, and yesterday this became public and especially humiliating in a way that shook even Hamas’s biggest admirers in the Strip.

Gazan and Palestinian users on social media did not spare Hamas, and the extent of the schadenfreude and mockery was (and still is) very broad, more than in the past. The image was crushed under the wheels of the white commercial vehicle in which al-Arabid was kidnapped.

Supporters of the PA and Fatah mocked: “Look, Gaza has become like the West Bank. The occupation forces enter and arrest whoever they want.” Hamas, which has always criticized the PA’s apparatuses for allowing the IDF’s movement and arrests inside Area A, now got a taste of its own medicine...

Beyond that, there is a further, internal Hamas effect: Hamas’s operatives and senior officials now also fear the information al-Arabid will reveal under arrest, and understand that if it happened to him, it could happen to them as well. Their personal security has been further undermined.

Israel can enter anywhere in the Strip and extract whoever it wants. This is a (proven—after yesterday) capability that did not exist before (or at least was never exposed so publicly).

Another issue raised among Gazan users:
Hamas’s weapons did not help it stop the operation. So what is the use of the weapons—because of Hamas’s refusal to hand them over, the reconstruction of the Strip has not begun?

Another interesting point was the schadenfreude of all Hamas’s opponents who were directly harmed by al-Arabid, who, as mentioned, was responsible, among other things, for suppressing Hamas’s internal opposition. They were glad he is finally getting his punishment for what he did to them...

Yesterday’s operation undermined the basic principles on which Hamas’s rule in the Strip is based, and further eroded Hamas’s power over its Gazan subjects.

ראש הממשלה בנימין נתניהו ביקר היום (ד׳) במוצב צה״ל הסמוך לקו הצהוב ברצועת עזה, יחד עם הרמטכ״ל, רב-אלוף אייל זמיר, מפקד פיקוד הדרום, אלוף יניב עשור, ומפקד אוגדת ׳הבזק׳ (99), תת-אלוף אלעד צורי.

ראש הממשלה קיבל סקירה מהמפקדים בשטח על פעילות כוחות צה״ל במרחב הקו הצהוב, על המשימות המבצעיות בגזרה ועל המאמץ להסרת איומים ולשמירה על ביטחון הכוחות והיישובים.

ראש הממשלה בנימין נתניהו:

״אני פה בתוך רצועת עזה עם הרמטכ"ל, עם אלוף הפיקוד ועם המפקדים והחיילים הגיבורים שלנו. אנחנו שולטים פה על השטח. אתם יכולים לראות את אשקלון שם, אתם יכולים לראות את כל היישובים שלנו מכל הכיוונים: את שדרות, את נתיבות, את הקיבוצים.

אנחנו שולטים בשטח. אנחנו לא נסוגים. אנחנו נשארים בקו הזה. אנחנו שולטים ב-60% מהרצועה, ועוד היד נטויה כי אנחנו מחסלים את המחבלים שמאיימים עלינו, עושים את זה חדשות לבקרים. אתמול לקחנו את ראש השב"כ של החמאס. בטח נלמד כמה דברים.

אבל אנחנו עושים הכל כדי להגיע ליעד שלנו - פירוק החמאס מנשקו ופירוז עזה. עזה לא תהווה יותר איום על ישראל. היעד הזה למעשה במידה רבה כבר הושג, ויש עוד עבודה להשלים - ואנחנו נשלים אותה״.

לראש הממשלה התלוו ראש הסגל, ראש המל״ל ומזכירו הצבאי.
